title: Host Program Terms: Deductible on HostCover Property-Damage Claims
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) property-damage claims: the deductible by host program and listing.**

The property deductible multiplier follows the host's program and the listing. A host account on a professional tier (Professional Host, Professional Host Plus or Enterprise Partner) whose listing under the plan is an Entire Home or a Luxury Villa bears 1.5 times the property claim's deductible share. A host whose account tier is Superhost, with a Superhost run that began on or before the stay's check-in date (the date the host service fee was assessed on the stay), on a plan with no claim from another stay reimbursed in the 12 months before the settlement date, bears 0.5 times the share. Every other host bears the share as it stands.

The property claim's deductible share is the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the same stay.

## Records read

- Host tier, Superhost-since date and the date the host service fee was assessed on the stay: Host Accounts.
- Space type of the listing under the plan: Listings.
- Claims from other stays reimbursed: the HostCover plan's ledger, reimbursements posted in the 12 months before the settlement date, leaving out those on the same stay.

## Matrix

| Host tier (Host Accounts) | Listing space type | Further condition | Deductible borne |
|---|---|---|---|
| Professional Host, Professional Host Plus or Enterprise Partner | Entire Home or Luxury Villa | none | 1.5 times the share |
| Professional Host, Professional Host Plus or Enterprise Partner | any other space type | none | the share as it stands |
| Superhost | any | run began on or before check-in and no other-stay reimbursement in the 12 months | 0.5 times the share |
| Superhost | any | run began after check-in, or one or more other-stay reimbursements in the 12 months | the share as it stands |
| Starter Host or Standard Host | any | none | the share as it stands |

## Hypothetical figures

With a deductible share of 250.00: an Enterprise Partner whose plan covers a Luxury Villa bears 375.00; the same host on an Entire Apartment bears 250.00; a Superhost since before check-in with no other-stay reimbursement in the 12 months bears 125.00.
